caption: The drawing consists of two objects, both resembling the outline of a heart shape created from what appears to be metal. The top object is a large, rust-colored, heart-shaped piece with three round holes, one near each top curve of the heart and one near the bottom tip. The texture appears rough and mottled, suggesting corrosion or age. Below this, there is a smaller, similarly shaped heart object depicted at an angle, with three short legs extending downward from the points where holes are present on the upper object, making it look like a stand. The color palette is dominated by shades of brown and gray on a light, beige background. The lower left corner of the image contains small, printed text with the name "HARLEY GROSSEN."
title: Trivet
